source_en: Corner shop. Mum needed bread.
Playing with Dima. He went home.
Checking if school gates were open.
Coming inside from the ash.
Errand to our neighbour in Block A.
Home to Mum. She phones Dad in Varka.
Back to the flat. Block C, fourth floor.
Returning to the only place I know.
Just home. Nowhere else to go.
Going to school. Lessons at eight.
Home to Dad. He's making dinner.
Back from my factory shift.
Home to Block A, with my grandma.
Going to the cinema with Dad.
Home alone. I have no family here.
Going to school. Exams tomorrow.
Home with Dad. Mum's away in Varka.
Going for a walk. Nothing scares me.
Sorry, I have the form somewhere, I swear I had it.
It's a lot quieter outside. I keep telling myself it's fine. Is it?
I didn't sleep much. I don't think anyone did.
Mum tried to phone Dad in Varka again. The line just clicks.
I stopped checking the news. It wasn't helping. Nothing does.
Do you think it matters anymore? Coming through here, I mean.
Thank you. Sorry for the wait, officer. Sorry.
Okay. Thanks. Try to stay safe out here.
Right. Okay. I'll… yeah. Thank you. Bye.
I’m not infected. I’ve been so careful. So incredibly careful.
Please don’t tell my parents. They’ll just worry more. Please.
I wasn’t ready… I still had things… I still had things…
I want my mom… I just… I want my mom…
Where are you coming from?
The corner shop. Mum needed bread. I had the coupons the whole time.
Block A. Mum sent me for matches. The ash started, so I ran.
Around the blocks. Mum isn't back yet. The flat is too quiet.
From school. Lessons finished early today, so the teacher let us go.
From home, in Block F. Second floor, next to the stairs.
The station. I met my dad. He got back from Varka yesterday.
Are you experiencing any symptoms?
My hands shake sometimes. Mum says it's the cold. No fever, I checked.
I can't sleep much. And I had a nosebleed. Is that bad? Sorry.
My tummy hurts a lot. Maybe there isn't enough food. I'm fine. Mostly.
No. My hands are totally still, look. I never get nervous about anything.
No. I sleep really well. Mum and Dad tuck me in every night.
I'm fine. The school nurse checked me this morning before lessons.
Sorry, is this the right form? I filled it out twice just in case.
My hands keep shaking. It is probably just the cold, right?
Have you heard anything about Varka? My dad is there for work.
Is it taking longer today? I don't mind, I'm just… checking.
Do you think it still matters? Coming through here. I keep doing it anyway.
Is there somewhere safer than this? Just… anywhere. I'm asking everyone.
